entities.name: PMID:25096924
observations: Korean occupational cohort study of 12,030 men examining HDL-C, C-reactive protein, and coronary artery calcium.
Abstract reports adjusted CRP–CAC associations by HDL-C strata; formal CRP×HDL-C interaction P value is not available in the abstract.

entities.name: HDL-C-stratified CRP-CAC association
observations: In Korean men, highest versus lowest CRP group had adjusted odds ratio 1.41 (95% CI 1.04–1.90; P=0.027) for CAC>0 in the lowest HDL-C quartile, versus 0.80 (95% CI 0.46–1.39; P=0.425) in the highest HDL-C quartile; abstract gives no formal interaction P value.
